shared_elements: upright freestanding carved slab/pillar with relief on the broad face
relief animal figures shown in profile
a horizontal band of repeated motifs across the upper part
zoomorphic head with eye and open mouth
elongated snake-like/limbed creature descending the shaft
repeated small rectangular units in a row
justification: Both are tall upright slabs with low relief organised into an upper zone carrying a row of repeated units above a lower zone with profile creatures, which gives a loose compositional echo. But the depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows an elaborately costumed standing human figure in frontal pose with headdress, plaque-like ornaments and blocky glyph-like signs, while B shows no human figure at all, instead a register of quadrupeds and birds above a large descending snake-like animal and a long-necked bird, rendered in a plainer, rounded, purely animal idiom.
